card.name: Gap before a second number or unit
card.fires_on: The space or opening parenthesis right after a measurement (such as metres, km2, cm, mg) where a second figure comes next. The next figure is a converted unit or a second dose or value.

modes.label: Metric to imperial conversion
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after a metric measurement, just before the converted imperial value.

modes.label: Space before next dose or value
modes.description: A space after a number in a dose or table, just before another number.

card.plain: It marks the point right after a measurement where a second number, often a converted unit, is about to appear.
